title: Trace a base multi-region write quorum
description: Inject voting and region failures in a five-voter base multi-region model. Active routes show who participates; selecting a component explains its role.

nodes.label: Application
nodes.detail: Uses the Spanner client library. Place latency-sensitive writers near the default leader region and keep retried transaction functions idempotent.

nodes.label: Leader replica
nodes.detail: Processes writes for its split first, logs the mutation, and forwards it in parallel to the other voting replicas.

nodes.label: Region A peer
nodes.detail: Maintains a full copy, serves reads, votes on writes, and can assume leadership when the current leader replica fails.

nodes.label: Region B replica 1
nodes.detail: Maintains a full copy, serves reads, votes on writes, and is eligible for leadership if the default leader region is lost.

nodes.label: Region B replica 2
nodes.detail: Provides the second read-write copy in the non-default region and participates in write quorum and leader election.

nodes.label: Witness replica
nodes.detail: Votes on writes and leader elections but does not maintain a full data copy, serve reads, or become leader.

nodes.label: Read-only replica
nodes.detail: Maintains a full copy and serves reads. It does not vote, increase the write quorum, or become leader.

scenarios.label: Healthy write
scenarios.summary: The split leader forwards the mutation to the four other voting replicas in parallel. Commit can finish after the leader and enough additional voters form a three-vote majority.
scenarios.result: The application receives a committed result after a majority agrees; the write does not wait for the optional read-only replica to vote.

scenarios.label: One voter down
scenarios.summary: One read-write replica is unavailable. The leader can still collect a majority from the remaining voting replicas.
scenarios.result: Writes remain possible because four voters are available and only three votes are required in this five-voter model.

scenarios.label: Leader replica down
scenarios.summary: The current leader replica fails, but the second read-write replica in the default leader region is healthy and can assume leadership.
scenarios.result: Transactions can resume after leader change and routing recovery. Retried application work must not duplicate external side effects.

scenarios.label: Leader region down
scenarios.summary: Both read-write replicas in the default leader region are unavailable. A replica in the second read-write region can become leader and form a majority with its peer and the witness.
scenarios.result: Read and write service moves to the second read-write region; client latency and error behavior can change during detection, election, and rerouting.

scenarios.label: Majority down
scenarios.summary: Three voting replicas are unavailable. The two remaining full read-write copies cannot form a majority to order new commits.
scenarios.result: New writes cannot commit until quorum returns. Existing copies are not permission to accept divergent writes.

scenarios.label: Nearby stale read
scenarios.summary: A sufficiently stale read can use a nearby caught-up read-only replica without making that replica part of the write quorum.
scenarios.result: Read locality can improve while the five-voter write path stays unchanged; the application must explicitly accept the selected historical timestamp.
